faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions about CV & ATS
faq.a1: An ATS-friendly CV uses single or clean two-column layouts, standard fonts, and machine-readable text that recruitment parsing engines can extract accurately without dropping text.
faq.q2: Are all CV templates on InterVue free?
faq.a2: Yes, every CV template in our collection is 100% free to customize, preview, and download as a high-quality PDF.
faq.q3: Can I tailor my CV for Remote tech jobs?
faq.a3: Absolutely. You can highlight Remote work competencies, asynchronous collaboration tools, and distributed team experience.
